help.title: Quick Start for Skills Manager
help.description: Fastest path: install skills → open Global Workspace → click a Preset pill to activate. Press ⌘K anytime for the command palette. Use Project Workspaces, Git backup, and Settings as needed.

workflows.title: Recommended Workflows
workflows.description: Single-agent: install skills → open Global Workspace → click a Preset pill to activate, or hit + Add Skills to pick from your library and toggle target agents inline. Multi-project: open a Project Workspace and use the same Preset pills or + Add Skills picker for that project's agents. Multi-machine: turn on Git Backup in Settings to sync your library across devices.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Group skills into named presets. In any workspace, click a Preset pill to instantly activate or deactivate all its skills for the current agent scope. Active presets show ✓; partially installed ones show a count. Applying a preset is a one-time copy — not a live sync.

install.title: Install Skills
install.description: Import from local folders, Git repositories, archives, or the marketplace. Batch-import multiple skills from a folder at once.

sync.title: Library
sync.description: Browse all installed skills with bulk tag editing and per-agent sync toggles. Filter by source or tag — including an Untagged pill to surface skills missing labels. Click an agent icon on any skill card to install or remove that skill for that agent in one click; the always-visible delete button removes a skill from the central library. Click the card itself to view docs, version history, and agent sync details.

global.title: Global Workspace
global.description: Each agent gets its own page listing every skill in its global folder — including ones installed outside Skills Manager — so the view matches what the agent actually sees. Use + Add Skills to pull from your central library with inline target-agent chips, or use the All Agents overview to manage every installed agent at once. Skills that only exist in an agent folder can be deleted directly from the card.

projects.title: Project Workspaces
projects.description: Link a project to browse per-agent local skill folders, compare with the central library, and import or export changes. Use Preset pills to activate skill groups, or open + Add Skills to pick from your library with a multi-agent target picker.

backup.title: Backup & Sync
backup.description: Sign in with GitHub once on the Backup page — backups then run automatically, and devices connected to the same repository stay in sync with each other. If the same skill is edited on two devices, it shows up under "Needs attention" with three choices (keep mine / use remote / keep both); a safety snapshot precedes every choice. Secrets and machine-specific settings are never backed up.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage agent paths and toggles, add custom agents, drag to reorder how agents appear across the app, change sync mode, theme, text size, language, proxy, Git remote, AI search key, and check for app updates. Use Export Logs to bundle recent logs and install/remove/update/sync activity into a single zip when filing an issue.
